did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. The owner opened Market complaints, took the serious complaint on order M2026-000179 (a scratched phone case, paid on delivery) and pressed Send it back to the seller. Then the seller and the buyer opened their own pages.

checks.text: The order became "Sent back to you" on the seller's page, with the owner's note, and no new delivery cost was made
The seller's record changed to Sold: 240 - Sent back: 1 (1 orders) - Complaints: 2
The goods went back on the seller's shelf: the listing stock went from 3 to 4
The buyer's page says "This order was sent back to the seller." and the case reads Sent back with the owner's note

notes: Done by hand in the live browser. Found and fixed: a returned or cancelled order still told the buyer "You pay when it arrives.", and an online order told them the same. It now says "Nothing to pay for this order." for returned and cancelled orders and says nothing about paying on arrival for online orders.
The goods were not physically posted back; that cannot be shown in a browser. What is shown is what the system records and tells each side.

Seller: the order is Sent back to you, with our note
Buyer: the order was sent back to the seller; nothing to pay
